perspective:
Sara Manuelito’s available information:

- She and Shirley Whiteplume are long-time colleagues and close friends who have worked together at a community health center for several years.
- Sara attended the funeral of a mutual patient. She observed Shirley appearing somber and suspected Shirley was deeply affected by the loss.
- At the funeral, Sara heard Shirley say it had been tough and that she kept thinking whether more could have been done. Sara told Shirley she had seen how much Shirley cared for him, that they did everything they could, and that they should remember the good care and joy they brought him. Shirley replied it was hard to let go.
- During a coffee break, Sara raised the topic of the patient’s treatment decisions, saying she sensed Shirley might feel burdened. Shirley said she felt responsible and wondered if pushing for a different approach might have given him a better chance. Sara said they made the best decisions with the information they had and that Shirley should not carry the burden alone. Shirley said she appreciated it but found it hard to accept.
- Later, Sara observed Shirley behaving reserved and minimally expressive. In their office, Sara told Shirley she had noticed she was holding back feelings and that it was okay to be open. Shirley said she was not sure she could and did not want to seem unprofessional or weak. Sara said showing emotion does not make her weak and is healthy among friends. Shirley said Sara might be right and that she would try to be more open.
- Afterward, Sara felt her previous confrontation might have been too harsh. She apologized to Shirley for coming on too strong. Shirley said it was a bit much but that she knew Sara meant well and appreciated the apology. Sara said she was there for Shirley however needed. Shirley thanked her and said they should keep talking because it helps.
- Later, Sara observed that Shirley seemed to be doing better. Sara asked how she was feeling; Shirley said she felt better thanks to their talks and Sara’s support. Sara offered to spend more time together outside work, and Shirley agreed, so they planned something for the weekend.
